verdict.rationale: While the docs describe token/instruction lifecycle management, mandate expiration (effectiveUntilTime), and purchase-intent cancellation, none of this evidence speaks to a user-facing data retention or deletion capability (e.g., deleting stored personal/consent data, retention policy disclosures). Missing for 10: explicit user data retention policy, a documented deletion/erasure mechanism for stored consumer data, and any privacy-rights tooling beyond payment-token revocation.
